items.title: Cantonal Statistical Database of Costa Rica
items.client: Council for the Promotion of Competitiveness of Costa Rica
items.summary: Design, structuring, and migration of a relational database to store and process statistical data for Costa Rican cantons.
items.description: Analyzed functional project requirements through meetings with organizational stakeholders to define system requirements. Designed the architecture using diagrams and use cases to plan development. Executed data migration ensuring integrity and structure. Implemented Stored Procedures and functions to automate statistical computations previously carried out manually in Microsoft Excel. Deployed the solution to Microsoft Azure for cloud management and high availability.

items.title: Management Web System & REST API
items.summary: Comprehensive web management platform for student enrollment, faculty, classes, and musical instrument inventory.
items.description: Participated in developing a full management web system. Built the backend using .NET (C#). Designed and implemented the relational database in Microsoft SQL Server. Developed a REST API to integrate the web frontend with the database. Implemented secure password handling, automated email notifications, and data processing pipelines. Collaborated on the frontend using React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript within a cross-functional team.

items.title: yourFirstJob - Cross-Platform App
items.summary: Mobile job search application built for university students seeking their first career opportunities.
items.description: Developed a job search application for students using .NET MAUI. Designed user interfaces and usability flows. Built a backend API in C#. Modeled and implemented the database with Microsoft SQL Server, deploying both the API and database directly to Microsoft Azure.
